verdict.rationale: Fathom documents event-triggered automation of its own: webhooks registered via the UI or API POST new meeting content to a URL of your choice, CRM fields update automatically after meetings, and keyword alerts monitor key topics. These are fixed triggers with limited configuration (payload include-flags, keywords), not a general user-defined rule engine. missing for 10: a configurable rule builder with conditions and choosable actions, event types beyond new meeting content, detailed docs on keyword-alert behavior, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Webhooks will send your meeting data (optionally including the summary, transcript, and action items) to a URL of your choice.
Create a webhook to receive new meeting content. At least one of `include_transcript`, `include_crm_matches`, `include_summary`, or `include_action_items` must be true.
You also have the option of creating and deleting webhooks with an API call.
CRM field sync, updating records after meetings automatically
Collaboration using comments, folders, keyword alerts, + more
